title: Courtyard replanting for a Fernwood strata

seo.title: Sample project: Fernwood strata courtyard
seo.description: Sample case study: a shaded Fernwood strata courtyard replanted with shade-tolerant natives, chosen by council from two written options.

summary: A shaded courtyard with failing shrubs replanted with shade-tolerant natives.
challenge: Half the shrubs in a shaded courtyard had died, owners disagreed about what to plant, and residents needed a clear path to their doors throughout.
approach: We gave council two written planting options, each with a plant list suited to deep shade, so the decision could be made at one meeting.
Work ran in two halves. Failed shrubs came out, the soil was amended and the chosen natives went in with new edging and mulch while the other half stayed open.
result: Council chose a plan from written options, and residents kept access throughout.
